description: This file defines API routes for managing input variables extracted from robot test files, including endpoints for retrieving variables at the test file level and a deprecated endpoint for test case variables.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: get_test_file_variables
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve all file-level variables for a specific test file ID.

methods.name: get_testcase_variables_deprecated
methods.description: Asynchronous function to provide a deprecated endpoint for retrieving test case variables, with migration guidance.
